title: Kendrick Bourne hopes to remain with 49ers in 2026

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kendrick Bourne hopes to remain with 49ers in 2026
sources.description: 49ers wide receiver Kendrick Bourne signed a one-year contract to return to the team after being cut by the Patriots last year and he'd like his second stint with the team to last a little longer.
